CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_operational_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when regexp_replace(p_phone,'[^0-9]','','g') ~ '^[2-9][0-9]{9}$' then '+1'||regexp_replace(p_phone,'[^0-9]','','g')
 when regexp_replace(p_phone,'[^0-9]','','g') ~ '^1[2-9][0-9]{9}$' then '+'||regexp_replace(p_phone,'[^0-9]','','g') end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_pending_opportunity_count(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select count(*)::integer from public.icash_screening_jobs s
 left join public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o on o.screening_id=s.id and o.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=p_account and not public.icash_owner_preflight_empty(s.account_id,s.id,s.snapshot) and s.created_at>now()-interval '24 hours'
 and (s.state in ('queued','running') or (s.state='complete' and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
  and not coalesce(o.attempted,false) and not coalesce(o.responded,false) and not coalesce(o.opted_out,false)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets t where t.account_id=s.account_id and t.screening_id=s.id and t.kind='contacts' and t.state='complete' and t.outcome='empty')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and c.manual)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_owner_contacts c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.screening_id=s.id and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c.result->'contacts','[]'::jsonb)) person
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(person->'phones','[]'::jsonb)) phone
  where person->'likelyOwner'='true'::jsonb and phone->'doNotCall' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb and length(coalesce(phone->>'number',''))>0))
  -- Changed sending identity is not fresh outreach inventory. Keep an
  -- unknown purchase, an alternative permission or any current-identity record
  -- in the buffer; absence of prepared operational evidence is not a failure.
  and not exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_owner_contacts owned
   join public.icash_operation_spend spend on spend.account_id=owned.account_id and spend.operation_key=owned.operation_key
    and spend.operation_key='owners:'||owned.account_id||':'||owned.screening_id
    and spend.state='settled' and spend.settled_at is not null
   join public.icash_customer_identities identity on identity.account_id=owned.account_id and length(trim(identity.principal))>0
   where owned.account_id=s.account_id and owned.screening_id=s.id and owned.result->>'propertyId'=s.snapshot->>'propertyId'
    and exists(select 1 from public.icash_operational_contacts old_contact
     where old_contact.account_id=s.account_id and old_contact.screening_id=s.id
      and old_contact.source_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(owned.result::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
      and length(trim(old_contact.sending_principal))>0 and old_contact.sending_principal is distinct from identity.principal)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operational_contacts current_contact
     where current_contact.account_id=s.account_id and current_contact.screening_id=s.id
      and current_contact.source_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(owned.result::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
      and current_contact.sending_principal=identity.principal)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_permissions permission
     where permission.account_id=s.account_id and permission.screening_id=s.id
      and permission.revoked_at is null and permission.permission_until>now())
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend held
     join public.icash_screening_jobs prior on held.operation_key='owners:'||s.account_id||':'||prior.id
      and prior.account_id=s.account_id and prior.snapshot->>'propertyId'=s.snapshot->>'propertyId'
     where held.account_id=s.account_id and held.state in ('reserved','dispatched'))
  )
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_deal_files d where d.account_id=s.account_id and d.screening_id=s.id and d.stage in ('closed','cancelled','cancellation_pending','under_contract','purchase_signed','buyer_selected','assigned','title_open','closing'))));
$function$
